notes: Two independent review passes reached the same substantive error conclusion. S1 and S2 correctly establish that active after an edge must equal whether the post-edge count is nonzero. The earliest error is S3.3, which states that any pre-edge cnt>0 produces next_active=1 while decrementing the counter. This is false at the expiration boundary: with cnt==1 and no trigger, next_cnt becomes zero and active must become low immediately after that edge. The error therefore confuses the current nonzero count with the next-state nonzero condition. In the second review, the cnt==1 boundary was independently reconstructed and produced the same contradiction. The final RTL avoids the process error by assigning active from next_cnt!=0 and therefore implements the exact PULSE_CYCLES duration correctly. Trusted directed simulation and bounded formal verification pass all configured obligations.
